scope: Experimental basic-land catalog, two external seats, BO1, host_assigned start, mulligan none. Not general SpellBench card/decision support.
working_tree: uncommitted spike on top of base revision
execution: Protocol checks rerun together after capability restriction; games check ran six seat-swapped first/uniform games separately. Every official check is included below.

adapter_integration_tests.execution: Five-test suite plus added EOF-during-startup test; final cleanup subset passed both tests.

build_artifacts.assets_provenance: Reused pre-existing local framed archive for this build. Normal documented build regenerates assets from the pinned Forge source. Catalog limited to Mountain and Forest.

arena_run.reason: SpellBench disk-reserve guard requires 60 GiB; development filesystem had approximately 6 GiB free. Official conformance games did execute.

golden_transcripts: Inspected, not replayed as Forge tests: the upstream fake-engine identities and scenario states are engine-specific.
limitations: Published Forge-WASM 0.2.0 is incompatible; rebuilt engine extensions are required.
London refused because the pinned engine/harness can offer an extra mulligan beyond an empty starting hand.
No arbitrary decklists, spell casting, targeting, payment, combat, triggers or replacements in the adapter catalog.
No general randomness/noninterference or native object-incarnation guarantee outside the catalog.
No full repository lint/typecheck gate was run; scoped checks are listed above.
